ocl.definition: const reserves:Set(Reserve) = Reserve.allInstance()->select(res | res.ReservedUser.UserID = uid and res.ReservedCopy.Barcode = barcode)
ocl.postcondition: reserves->forAll(res:Reserve | res.IsReserveClosed = true) and reserves->forAll(res:Reserve | res.ReservedCopy.IsReserved = false) and result = true
